text:
Which statement explains the meaning of the half-life of a radioactive substance?
A
half the time taken for half the substance to decay
B
half the time taken for the substance to decay completely
C
the time taken for half the substance to decay
D
the time taken for the substance to decay completely

options.label: A
options.text: half the time taken for half the substance to decay

options.label: B
options.text: half the time taken for the substance to decay completely

options.label: C
options.text: the time taken for half the substance to decay

options.label: D
options.text: the time taken for the substance to decay completely
